get.description: Starts with a `ready` event, then `change` events, each `{"type":"change","areas":[...]}` with the areas (structure, teams, projects, tasks, sso) where something you can see changed: reload what's on screen through the API. A `ping` event every 25 seconds shows the stream is alive. A `resync` event means changes may have been missed: reload everything. Events never carry content. The stream ends when you sign out, your session ends, or you leave the organization; browsers reconnect after a drop.
